rules.name: Visible focus
rules.requirement: Interactive controls expose a visible focus treatment.

rules.name: Button contrast
rules.requirement: Primary button text/background contrast is at least 4.5:1.

rules.name: Input error identification
rules.requirement: Automatically detected input errors identify the affected field and describe the error in text.

rules.name: Danger text contrast
rules.requirement: Danger text on the primary surface has at least 4.5:1 contrast.

rules.name: Invalid border contrast
rules.requirement: An invalid control border used as a state cue has at least 3:1 contrast against the primary surface.
